false_positive.why: The fit-out needs one designer; the app suggests both Architect and Interior Design. Counts only when Interior Design is also present (the alias covers the other case).

The fire services engineer covers the fire service connection and backflow device; the tea point plumbing is plumber design-and-install. A separate hydraulic engineer is not needed unless amenities change (fit-out-amenities).

On a deemed-to-satisfy CDC the certifier's assessment and the engineers' design certificates cover compliance. A separate BCA consultant comes with a performance solution (performance-solution trigger). Owner to confirm (DOMAIN.md §12).

Open-plan refit with no change to amenities, entrances or paths of travel beyond the floor; the certifier checks access within the new work. Access joins under fit-out-amenities or affected-part-access.
